responsibility: Defines MIPS inline-assembly register classes and registers, including architecture-dependent integer type support for MIPS32 versus MIPS64, floating-point register availability, reserved-register diagnostics, and operand emission.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `abi/call/mips.rs`, this MIPS file defines the inline `asm!` register set, including MIPS32 vs MIPS64 type support, floating-point registers, and reserved-register diagnostics, rather than offset-sensitive function-call ABI lowering.
